python3 - <<'PY'
import json, os, socket, time
SECS = int("60")
LOG = "/etc/sceptre/log/watcher-stderr.log"
res = {"host": socket.gethostname(), "log": LOG, "seconds": SECS, "error": None,
       "max_per_min": int("2048"),
       "size": None, "grew": None}
try:
    s0, t0 = os.path.getsize(LOG), time.time()
    time.sleep(SECS)
    res["size"] = os.path.getsize(LOG)
    res["grew"] = max(0, res["size"] - s0)
    res["seconds"] = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
except Exception as e:
    res["error"] = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
finally:
    json.dump(res, open(f"/tmp/burger-watcher-{res['host']}.json", "w"))
    print(json.dumps(res))
PY
